in_marathi.name: Ajeeta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Not Obtained, Not Touched
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajeeta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajeeta is a Sanskrit name for a girl, which means 'Not Obtained' or 'Not Touched'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ajah' which means 'not born'. It is a name given to a child who is yet to come into this world or one who has not been touched by worldly desires and material possessions. Ajeeta is a name that symbolizes purity, innocence, and detachment.
